# Spring for Better Schools

> David Spring's campaign for Washington State Superintendent of Public Instruction focused on education reform, local school control, and full funding.

This site presents David Spring's platform for the Washington State Superintendent of Public Instruction position, centered on four major policy pillars: cleaning up Olympia's education politics, restoring local school board control, fully funding public schools, and ending high-stakes testing like SBAC. The campaign critiques current education policy, school funding mechanisms, and pandemic-era policies affecting Washington students.

## Key Topics

- Superintendent of Public Instruction
- Washington State education policy
- School funding and McCleary case
- Local school control
- High-stakes testing and SBAC
- Education reform
- Public schools
- School board authority
- Washington State Constitution
- Class sizes
- Corporate welfare
- Pandemic policies
- Property taxes
- School closures
- Political campaign

## Campaign Overview

- [Spring for Better Schools!](https://springforbetterschools.org): David Spring's campaign for Washington State Superintendent of Public Instruction
- [Meet David Spring](https://springforbetterschools.org/meet-david-spring): Biography and background of candidate David Spring

## Campaign Platforms

- [#1 Clean Up Olympia](https://springforbetterschools.org/1-clean-up-olympia): Campaign platform #1: Education policy reform and school funding
- [#2 Restore Local Control of Public Schools](https://springforbetterschools.org/2-restore-local-control-of-public-schools): Campaign platform #2: Local school control and parental involvement
- [#3 Fully Fund Schools](https://springforbetterschools.org/3-fully-fund-schools): Campaign platform #3: Full school funding and education investment
- [#4 End High Stakes Testing](https://springforbetterschools.org/4-end-high-stakes-testing): Campaign platform #4: Opposition to standardized testing and SBAC

## School Funding & Finance

- [How to Cut our Property Taxes in Half](https://springforbetterschools.org/1-clean-up-olympia/how-to-cut-our-property-taxes-in-half): Tax reform proposal addressing McCleary levy and property taxes
- [A Crime Against our Children](https://springforbetterschools.org/1-clean-up-olympia/a-crime-against-our-children): Critique of school funding policy and levy swipe practices
- [Decoding the Fake $5 Billion "Increase" in School Funding](https://springforbetterschools.org/3-fully-fund-schools/decoding-the-fake-5-billion-increase-in-school-funding): Analysis of Washington state school funding claims and McCleary case
- [Why Ending Corporate Welfare is Required by the Washington State Constitution](https://springforbetterschools.org/3-fully-fund-schools/why-ending-corporate-welfare-is-required-by-the-washington-state-constitution): Constitutional argument for eliminating tax breaks to fund schools
- [Answers to the Supreme Court McCleary Questions](https://springforbetterschools.org/3-fully-fund-schools/answers-to-the-supreme-court-mccleary-questions): Response to Washington Supreme Court McCleary case requirements
- [Our Constitution Requires Full Funding for Higher Ed](https://springforbetterschools.org/3-fully-fund-schools/our-constitution-requires-full-funding-for-higher-ed): Constitutional argument for full funding of higher education
- [Washington Legislature Risks the Health & Safety of Half a Million Students](https://springforbetterschools.org/3-fully-fund-schools/washington-legislature-risks-the-health-safety-of-half-a-million-students): Critique of school infrastructure and safety funding failures

## Local Control & School Governance

- [Restore Local Control of Public Schools](https://springforbetterschools.org/2-restore-local-control-of-public-schools/restore-local-control-of-public-schools): Detailed policy proposal for restoring local school board authority

## High-Stakes Testing & Assessment

- [Why I Oppose the Toxic SBAC Test](https://springforbetterschools.org/4-end-high-stakes-testing/why-i-oppose-the-toxic-sbac-test): Detailed critique of SBAC standardized testing in Washington
- [Why it is Reprehensible to use Toxic Tests to Rank our Schools](https://springforbetterschools.org/4-end-high-stakes-testing/why-it-is-reprehensible-to-use-toxic-tests-to-rank-our-schools): Criticism of using SBAC test results to rank schools

## Education & Pandemic Policy

- [Why Washington State has the Highest Class Sizes in the Nation](https://springforbetterschools.org/3-fully-fund-schools/why-washington-state-has-the-highest-class-sizes-in-the-nation): Analysis of class sizes and education funding impact in Washington
- [Why the Superintendent Should Not Blackmail the Legislature with the Threat of Closing Schools](https://springforbetterschools.org/3-fully-fund-schools/why-the-superintendent-should-not-blackmail-the-legislature-with-the-threat-of-closing-schools): Critique of superintendent tactics in school funding negotiations
- [How corrupt politicians misused the PCR Test](https://springforbetterschools.org/1-clean-up-olympia/how-corrupt-politicians-misused-the-pcr-test): Critique of PCR testing policies during COVID-19 pandemic
- [How Mask Mandates severely harmed our Children](https://springforbetterschools.org/1-clean-up-olympia/how-mask-mandates-severely-harmed-our-children): Opposition to mask mandates in Washington schools during pandemic
